fix(engine): S55 F-083 — ART-sized engine stack + loud recursion-limit drop (fixes R-NEW-361 Dooz probe spin)

Root cause (dispatch-trace proven): 55 of 56 Ln/a;.r (Kotlin LongArray-fill
helper) invocations executed; the 56th — Lh/r;.d initializing ScatterMap
o5051 — entered try_recursive_invoke at depth=80 == MAX_RECURSION_DEPTH and
was SILENTLY dropped onto the API bridge (EXP-053: ~80KB C++ stack per DEX
frame -> 80-frame cap under the 8MB process stack). The dropped void
initializer left the metadata at heap-zero; the subsequent sentinel write
produced ghost bytes (0xff007f6600000000, zero EMPTY 0x80) and the
findImpl probe never terminated (HALT-LOOP -> synthetic aput-oob).

Fix (generic, no interpreter-layout change):
1. cmd_run executes the engine on a dedicated pthread with a 1GB VIRTUAL
   stack (Linux commits on touch) — ART contract: app recursion is bounded
   by the thread stack, not a fixed frame count.
2. MAX_RECURSION_DEPTH 80 -> 2048 (~164MB worst case, inside the
   reservation, still bounded against runaway recursion).
3. The limit-drop is ALWAYS loud ([RECURSION-LIMIT] stderr) — a dropped
   void initializer is a state-corrupting event and must never be silent.
4. Hygiene: the F-074 super-dispatch trace was ALWAYS-ON stderr including a
   heap message lookup per inherited call, throttling Compose-heavy apps to
   ~1.6K instr/s; now env-gated (MINIANDROID_F074_TRACE), law unchanged.
5. Env-gated diagnostics (MINIANDROID_F040_DIAG): TRI-F040 depth probe,
   R361-STORE metadata trace, R376-DIRECT ctor-dispatch probe, R-INSN
   instruction stream — R-NEW-361/376 evidence tooling.

The fixture exposed six generic engine defects (each independently
discriminated by the new char_probe fixture before/after):

1. LayoutParams constructors: programmatic UIs construct
   LinearLayout.LayoutParams(w,h[,weight]) etc. — stub android.jar has no

   gravity/margins/weight into the ViewShadow (also via setLayoutParams).
2. setContentView(View) never ran measure/layout — programmatic trees fell
   to the legacy estimator where width=0+weight collapses to zero size and
   weighted rows rendered nothing. Now runs the SAME real measure_layout
   pass as XML-inflated trees; ResourceRuntime.inflater() no longer
   dereferences null for APKs without resources.arsc.
3. Signature-aware return typing: execute_return retypes raw INT32 by the
   method's return descriptor (Z/C/B/S) — booleans printed 0/1, chars
   printed their int codes.
4. Signature-aware param retyping: build_invoke_args converts C/Z/B/S
   params (previously only F/J/D).
5. IMPLEMENT_IF_22T + arithmetic/array-index macros collapsed every
   non-INT32 primitive to 0 — a char param compared as 0 made EMPTY BOARD
   CELLS match a win check (dalvik_int_value now covers all integer-like
   types, same law as EXP-093 if-eqz).
6. The 10-call method throttle stubbed compiler-generated synthetic
   access$N trampolines after 11 calls, silently nulling every subsequent
   outer-field read mid-game ('null WINS'). access$* is now exempt.
